host.description: Hostname or IP address of the AMT device.

use_digest.description: Use HTTP Digest authentication (required by most AMT devices).

use_tls.description: Connect to the AMT device over TLS.

self_signed_allowed.description: Accept a self-signed TLS certificate from the AMT device.

log_amt_messages.description: Log raw WS-Management XML messages for debugging.

is_redirection.description: Use the AMT redirection port instead of the management port.

pinned_cert.description: PEM-encoded certificate to pin for the AMT TLS connection.

allow_insecure_cipher_suites.description: Allow weak or legacy TLS cipher suites.

cert_path.description: Path to the PEM-encoded certificate file to push to the AMT device.

key_path.description: Path to the PEM-encoded PKCS#1 RSA private key file to push to the AMT device.
